Hi Lisa - Dev from Security/Infra here. Short answers and some details you can use in your security review: 

SOC 2 / Artifacts:
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (period Jan-Dec 2026). We can provide the SOC 2 report and AOC via our secure portal link (shared by Marissa). Sharing requires an NDA - we can put that in motion today.

BAA & Eligible Deployments:
- We will sign a BAA for customers running on Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) or Private (VPC or on-prem). These environments provide tenant isolation and encryption controls required for PHI processing.
- The standard multi-tenant hosted API (shared pool) is not approved for PHI and therefore not eligible for BAA coverage.
- There is no "partial hosted" tenancy option at the moment that meets our BAA controls - Dedicated or Private are the supported paths for PHI.

PHI handling / technical boundaries:
- Data in transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced.
- Data at rest: customer data encrypted with KMS; customers can bring their own KMS keys (BYOK) for Private and Dedicated (depending on contract).
- KV / prefix caching: we can configure to avoid persistent cache of user-provided prompts. If your workflow requires strict non-persistence, we can disable server-side prefix caching for the tenant in Dedicated/Private.
- Logs & telemetry: access logs and request/response traces are available to customers in Dedicated/Private. By default, certain telemetry is retained for 90 days; retention can be adjusted per contract for Dedicated/Private.
- Client-side tokenization: we support integrations and provide SDKs and reference patterns for client-side redaction/tokenization. That approach can reduce PHI exposure if you must remain on hosted; however, a BAA still cannot be executed for shared-hosted environments.

Typical customer recommendation:
- For PHI processing: sign BAA + run on Dedicated or Private.
- For evaluation / POC with redacted data: hosted API with client-side redaction is OK.

If you'd like, I can fill in the questionnaire (attached) with these controls and provide the precise policy text we use for retention and KMS.

Thanks,
